title: Loop status indicator error messaging improvements
body:
Currently, when the loop is disabled involuntarily an icon may appear indicating the error/paused status. If the user clicks the icon to find out more, the resulting message is confusing because it shows a green icon with no explanation.

e.g.
If the pump is being refilled
--> Loop icon displays in Yellow with a 'pause' indicator
Click the icon to learn more
--> The following appears:
[Loop green icon] Loop
[Cancel]

It would be preferable to show something like the following when error conditions arise:

Loop Status
-------------
<[Current Status icon]> <Current status>
<Explanation>

e.g.
Loop Status
-------------
[Loop paused icon] Paused by AAPS   
Reservoir refill

or

Loop Status
-------------
[Loop broken icon] Connection problem
No BG data (x minutes) | RileyLink unreachable (x minutes) | Pump unreachable (x minutes)

Tested on AAPS 3.0 B5
